experiment_data.hypothesis: Mixing samples from T=0.7 and T=1.0 significantly reduces degeneracy compared to single-T sampling (by breaking temperature-induced mode collapse), enabling entity construction to achieve significant ΔF1 improvement even in configs where single-T construction was n.s. due to high degeneracy.
experiment_data.notes: Hypothesis partially supported. T=0.7+T=1.0 mixed pool reduces degen (22.3%→17.0%) and improves construction (VC 3/3 seeds sig vs greedy), but cross-pool comparison (mixed vs T=1.0 alone) only 1/3 seeds significant. T gap matters: ΔT=0.2 (T=0.8+T=1.0) harmful, ΔT=0.3 (T=0.7+T=1.0) beneficial. VC weighting confirmed cross-T compatible. Awaiting Director conclusion classification.
